title: Convergence Analysis of STORM Under Different Geometries
summary: Stochastic recursive momentum (STORM) achieves fast convergence for nonconvex optimization via the variance reduction effect, but existing analyses rely on the strong average smoothness assumption. In this paper, we study the convergence of STORM for different objectives without average smoothness. We first revisit the results under average smoothness, obtaining the $O(T^{-1/3})$ bound for nonconvex objectives and the $O(σ^2/(μT))$ bound for last-iterate output under the $μ$-Polyak--Łojasiewicz~(PL) condition.
